description: Save an exact member-stated fact, confirm one reviewed suggestion, or delete one explicitly selected fact. Never compose or infer identity facts, nationality or date of birth. Protected demographic answers stay in the encrypted web vault. Residence and salary use update_profile. Work authorization must name its country in canonical_params. Read get_profile first; do not confirm unseen suggestions or delete unrequested facts.

canonical_params.description: Optional fact scope: country, technology, currency, period or employer. Use a country for work authorization.

fact_id.description: One owned fact returned by get_profile; required for confirm or delete.

name: save_answer

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; null for an unconfirmed suggestion.

mined_value.description: The most recent AI suggestion; may differ from value on a confirmed fact awaiting re-review.

params.description: Canonical parameters scoping a parameterized answer (e.g. {"country":"uk"}); empty object for a plain fact.

source.description: user = typed/confirmed by the person; mined = AI suggestion; answer = promoted from a screening answer they gave; memory = AI suggestion drawn from their chat with the NeverApply assistant.

title: Save your answer
